artworks.title: Cardinal Jules Mazarin
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving of a man from the waist up. He has distinct facial features with a prominent mustache and a small pointed beard. His hair is medium-length, slightly curled, receding. He wears a high-collared garment with detailed lace at his neck and a robe or cloak over his shoulders. He is adorned with elegant attire that could indicate nobility or a formal status. The man is framed by an elaborate wreath-like border with intricate detailing. At the bottom of the frame, there is a coat of arms. The background is filled with fine lines, creating a textured effect.

artworks.title: Cardinal Jules Mazarin
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Pieter van Mol
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man in three-quarter view. He has a mustache, goatee, and shoulder-length wavy hair, dressed in formal attire with a large collar and cloak. The background features an ornate oval frame with decorative motifs and a coat of arms at the bottom. The artwork is done in a detailed monochrome engraving style.

artworks.title: Cardinal Jules Mazarin
artworks.description: The image displays a man's upper body. He is positioned to the left with his head turned slightly towards the viewer. The man has a pronounced jawline, a pointed mustache, and a goatee. He has wavy hair falling to his shoulders, with receding temples. He is dressed in a formal shirt with a large collar and a lace tie. The portrait is surrounded by an oval frame with intricate detailing, and below it is a coat of arms with laurel leaves and decorative script text. The background features detailed lines for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Cardinal Jules Mazarin
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait of a man, focusing on his upper body in a three-quarter view. He has a mustache, a pointed chin beard, and long, neatly combed hair that partially covers his ears. He is dressed in a formal garment with a high, wide collar and a decorative clasp. The man appears to be wearing a cloak with visible patterns. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by him. The background features a repeated pattern of stars and an oval frame encircling his image, inscribed with text.

artworks.title: Cardinal Jules Mazarin
artworks.description: The image displays a bust-length portrait of a man in an oval frame. He is looking directly at the viewer, with a mustache and goatee. His hair is styled in waves. The man wears formal attire with intricate designs, including a large collar and a draped cape. The backdrop of the portrait features baroque elements like stars, crowns, and ribbons. The top has a cardinal's hat on a crown, while the bottom has crossed marshal batons and stars. The background is textured, adding to the composition's opulent appearance.

artworks.title: Chancellor Michel Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body portrait of a man positioned at an angle. He has slightly wavy, shoulder-length hair framing his face. The man has a mustache and a beard, with a composed expression. He is wearing attire typical of a formal period with a wide white collar and a dark cloak draped over his shoulders. He is set within an oval frame adorned with decorative ribbons. The background includes an intricately carved curved pedestal below the frame, featuring a coat of arms with a decorative design beneath it.

artworks.title: Chancellor Michel Le Tellier
artworks.description: This is an etched portrait of a man showing the upper half of his body. The man is turned halfway to the right, looking directly at the viewer. He has medium-length wavy hair, a neatly trimmed beard, and mustache. His clothing is detailed, with a large collar, a dark cape over one shoulder, and an ornate crest with a star on his chest. He wears a buttoned vest. The background has finely hatched lines, and the portrait is framed within an ornamental octagonal border. Below the portrait, there is a coat of arms within a crest.

artworks.title: Chancellor Michel Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. The man is facing slightly to his right, with a defined mustache, a goatee, and shoulder-length wavy hair. He is dressed in 17th-century attire, wearing a dark cloak with a large star emblem on the left shoulder, a white collar, and a sash diagonally crossing his chest. The background features a richly hatched oval frame with decorative patterns. Below the image is an ornate cartouche displaying a crest or coat of arms, surrounded by decorative elements.

artworks.title: Chancellor Michel Le Tellier
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a formal outfit, with intricate details, looking directly at the viewer.

artworks.title: Antoine Le Pautre
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a man depicted from the chest up. He is facing forward with shoulder-length curly hair and a mustache, wearing a cloak over a high-collared shirt. His portrait is framed by an ornate border with decorative elements, including leaves. Below the frame are two cherubic figures, one holding an artist's palette and the other holding a sculptor's tool. In the background, there is a classical architectural structure to the left, with high horizons and skies with scattered clouds.

artworks.title: Michel Le Masle
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a portrait. He is shown in three-quarter view, facing slightly to the right. The man has distinct features, including a prominent forehead, beard, mustache, and a calm expression. He wears a cap, high-collared shirt with visible buttons, and a broad cloak. The portrait is enclosed within an ornate oval frame with text and a heraldic shield with intricate designs below. The background features engraved lines and a decorative border within the frame.

artworks.title: Jacques Le Coigneux
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait of a man named Messire Iacqves Le Coigneux, Grand President au Parleme. The man is depicted facing slightly to the left, with a long, pointed nose and facial hair. He wears a square cap and a robe with fur trim. The background features an oval frame and an inscription with his name and title.

artworks.title: Jean Le Camus
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body facing slightly to his left, with long curly hair falling past his shoulders. He has a rounded nose, gentle eyes, and is wearing a high-collared garment with a large white collar and a dark garment underneath. The man is framed by an ornate oval frame with inscriptions on the top and bottom edges. The background inside the frame has a simple textured pattern.

artworks.title: Noel Le Boultz
artworks.description: The image is a bust-style portrait of a man. He is facing forward, with his body slightly turned to one side. The man has long, curly hair and distinct facial features, including a prominent nose and focused eyes. He is dressed in a historical garment with a large, white collar and textured fabric. The background includes inscriptions, a coat of arms, and a decorative oval frame.

artworks.title: Louis-Phelypeaux de La Vrilliere
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man facing slightly to his right but looking directly at the viewer. The man has long, wavy hair that falls around his shoulders and a pointed beard and mustache. He is wearing a dark robe with a light-colored lace-trimmed collar and a sash across his chest. The intricate details of his clothing suggest a historical or formal attire. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects that he is holding. The background consists of an elaborately detailed border with text around the oval frame, and below the frame, there is a coat of arms with ornamental designs. The entire image has a classical, engraved appearance with fine lines and shading.

artworks.title: Philibert-Emmanuel de Beaumanoir Lavardin
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a bust-length portrait of a man. The man is facing slightly to the left, with his body turned towards the viewer and his gaze directed at them. He has long, slightly wavy hair and wears a skullcap. His facial features include a prominent nose and a slightly serious expression. He wears a robe with a large collar and a chain with a large cross pendant around his neck. The portrait is framed with an intricate border featuring oak leaves and acorns, and a coat of arms with ornate design elements is in the lower part of the frame. The background of the portrait is textured with fine lines.

artworks.title: Philibert-Emmanuel de Beaumanoir Lavardin
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image displays a man in a portrait from the waist up, facing slightly left with a composed expression. He has a mustache, goatee, shoulder-length wavy hair, wearing a clerical robe with a visible large collar and a cape. He wears a chain with a cross pendant around his neck. The background has a textured pattern within an oval frame formed by dual lines. Below the oval, an ornate emblem features a shield with a building, with inscriptions "Thé: Chauenpin Pinx" on the left and "Rob: Nanteuil Sculpebat 1658" on the right.

artworks.title: Michel Larcher
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body in a formal portrait style. The man has a serious expression, long, narrow nose, defined lips, and shoulder-length wavy hair. He wears a robe with broad sleeves, intricate patterns, and a wide, white collar with pointed corners. A detailed emblem is below the oval frame surrounding the portrait. The background has finely engraved horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Guillaume de Lamoignon
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a portrait from the waist up, with long curly hair and a trimmed mustache and goatee. He is wearing a garment with a fur collar, set against a plain background in a rich, dark oval frame with an inscription. Below the portrait is lettering that may identify the individual or provide context.

artworks.title: Guillaume de Lamoignon
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man's upper body in a three-quarter position facing slightly to his left. The man has a long face with a pointed chin and a prominent nose, long dark wavy hair falling just past his shoulders, a mustache, and a small beard. He is dressed in a fur garment with visible fur lining. The image is framed by an oval border with inscriptions, and a coat of arms with intricate detailing is below the frame. The background has ornamental elements and text, with the focus remaining on the central figure.

artworks.title: Guillaume de Lamoignon
artworks.description: The image shows a man portrait from the chest up, looking towards the right. He has medium-length wavy hair, a high forehead, arched eyebrows, and a mustache with a small goatee. He wears a detailed garment with a fur-lined cloak or shawl over his shoulders and visible buttons on the inner shirt. The man appears well-dressed, and the portrait is framed in an oval with a coat of arms at the bottom. The background consists of parallel lines and an ornate border.

artworks.title: Marechal de La Meilleraye
artworks.artist: Robert Nanteuil after Justus van Verus
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait showing an upper body view of a man turned slightly to the left. The man's hair is long, wavy, and falls past his shoulders. He has a serious expression, pronounced cheekbones, a neatly trimmed mustache, and a pointed goatee. He is wearing formal armor with intricate detailing, including visible rivets and decorative patterns, along with a large white lace collar. The portrait is set within an oval frame. At the bottom is an ornate shield with various heraldic symbols, including a crescent moon. The background of the image is a simple lined pattern.

artworks.title: Pierre Lallemant
artworks.description: The image is an engraving featuring a portrait of a man. He is portrayed looking directly at the viewer with a calm expression. The man has a prominent forehead, short and combed-back thinning hair, and wears ecclesiastical attire, including a loose-fitting garment with pleated detailing and a distinctive collar. Fabric drapes over his shoulders, likely part of his robe. The portrait is enclosed in an ornate oval frame with an inscription along its border. The background features intricate line work that contrasts with the smooth rendering of the man's figure.

artworks.title: Denis de La Barde
artworks.description: This black and white engraving depicts a portrait of a man from the chest up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left and looking directly at the viewer. The man has distinct features, a high forehead, and a composed expression. His hair is shoulder-length and wavy, and he wears a skullcap. He is dressed in clerical robes, notably a dark, high-collared garment with intricate detailing. Around his neck hangs a large cross on a chain. The portrait is framed by an ornate leaf-patterned border and is placed on a pedestal-like structure displaying a decorative shield with a design. The background is filled with stippled shading that accentuates the contrast and contours of the engraving.
